meta.title: Asaex — Currency, made effortless
meta.description: A remittance marketplace between licensed exchange offices. Live rates, transparent fees, supervised settlement — usually within one business day.

footer.tagline: Currency, made effortless. You submit a transfer request, a licensed exchange office executes it, and every step runs under platform supervision.
footer.compliance: Asaex is a remittance marketplace between licensed exchange offices; it is not a custodial wallet or a securities venue and holds no deposits.

hero.title: Currency, made effortless
hero.subtitle: Submit a transfer request; a licensed exchange office executes it while every step — from the Toman deposit to the foreign receipt — runs under platform supervision. Usually within one business day.

how.title: How a transfer works
how.subtitle: Three clear steps; at each one you know what just happened and what comes next.

1.title: Submit & lock the rate
1.body: Set the amount and destination account; the rate locks for 15 minutes and eligible exchange offices see your request.

2.title: Office accepts, Toman funds
2.body: An office claims the request and chat opens. The Toman leg is funded inside the platform's supervised flow and confirmed by both sides.

3.title: Foreign leg & release
3.body: The office executes the foreign transfer and uploads proof; once receipt is confirmed, the Toman releases and your receipt is issued.

design.title: The Asaex design system
design.intro: Every token, component, and motion references this page — in both languages and both themes. It is how the three product surfaces (customer PWA, office panel, admin panel) stay coherent.

brand.description: The Asaex mark builds the letter A from two crossing currency flows — reading at once as an A, the exchange arrow-pair (⇄), and flowing water.
brand.markSizes: Legible from a 16px favicon up to a building sign
brand.lockup: Wordmark lockup — in Persian the mark sits on the right
brand.mono: Single-color version for stamps, receipts, and brand surfaces

rules.clearspace: Clear space: the mark's counter height, on all four sides
rules.never: Never: stretch, rotate, add drop shadows, or recolor outside the palette
rules.rtl: Not mirrored in RTL; the lockup order places the mark

colors.description: One deep green accent — trust plus Persian visual heritage, deliberately away from every fintech's blue.
colors.note: Up/down colors are never the only signal; an arrow glyph and an explicit +/− always ride along (a color-vision accessibility requirement).

type.description: Persian in Vazirmatn (1.75 leading), English in Inter (1.6). Display numerals are Persian in fa; inputs and identifiers stay Latin, and every figure is tabular.

layout.description: Spacing only from the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64 scale; radii 8/12/16/24; exactly three soft elevation levels.

components.description: Interface primitives: buttons, status badges, inputs, and loading skeletons — with touch targets of at least 44px.

validation.description: Validation is real, not cosmetic: Sheba via mod-97, cards via Luhn with BIN→bank lookup, and the national code via its check digit.

err.format: That's not a Sheba format — it starts with IR followed by digits only.
err.length: A Sheba needs exactly 24 digits after IR.
err.checksum: The Sheba check digits don't match — re-check the number.

card.label: Card number
card.hint: 16 digits; the bank is detected from the first six

err.format: A card number is exactly 16 digits.
err.checksum: The card checksum fails — one digit is off.

nid.label: National code
nid.err: Invalid national code — re-check the digits.

coins.description: Twenty currencies, one lighting rig: 45° camera, top-left key light, soft contact shadow, and the currency glyph embossed on the face.
coins.rule: The boundary rule: 3D icons are for currencies and product concepts; functional micro-UI (chevrons, close, search) stays a clean 2px line set — 3D at 16px is noise, not polish.

charts.description: Single series, 2px line, recessive grid, crosshair with tooltip. Value text always wears ink tokens, never the series color; the time axis stays left-to-right in both locales.
charts.note: Direction always pairs an arrow + sign so color is never the only signal.

motion.description: Motion is a product feature here, not decoration: 150–350ms for feedback, 600–1200ms for narrative moments; transform and opacity only.
motion.rules: Under the OS "reduce motion" setting everything collapses to static, and no animation ever blocks interaction or delays a money action.
motion.countdownNote: Below 60s it turns amber and pulses
motion.skeletonNote: Matched to the final layout so layout shift stays at zero

scenes.description: Every scene is built on one rig: the brand-tinted disc, the contact shadow, and the same stroke weight and coin silhouette as the logo and currency icons. SVG + Framer Motion, a few KB each, fully static under the OS reduce-motion setting.
